title: Combat Statistics Fix (unofficial) [Beta]
description:
Unofficial fix for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3781790213]Combat Statistics[/url] by [i]Blackdevil[/i]. All credit goes to the original author.

As with the original mod, this is only available on the public-beta branch.
This is only an extension, so the original mod is required. It doesn't affect gameplay, and can be used in multiplayer without other players needing it.

[b]What it fixes[/b]
- Continue button on defeat or victory screens, since [i]The Fool[/i] update [i]v0.113[/i] in November 2026
- [i]Wuppy[/i]'s damage absorbed and faints not being tracked, new since [i]v0.113[/i]
- [i]Osty[/i], power and relic damage sources not being tracked, since [i]v0.113[/i]
- Combat stats only working on the first fight of each game launch with certain other mods installed ([i]Into the Spireverse[/i], for example)

The code is public and viewable here, github.com/jciurc/sts2-combat-stats-fix
[hr][/hr]

Mod ID: CombatStatisticsFix
Author: symphony[/i]
changeNote: 0.2.0: first release. Fixes the Continue button and missing Osty and damage-source stats on game v0.113 and later, and the overlay showing only for the first fight, and adds Wuppy's stats.
